defs.def: very good, pleasant or enjoyable 精彩的；绝妙的；令人高兴的；使人愉快的

ex.s: Bring along your camera and enjoy the wonderful views along this well-surfaced forest path.
ex.t: 带上相机，沿着这条铺设平整的森林小径欣赏美景吧。

ex.s: While taking a 20-hour train ride along the edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwestern China, I had the kind of humbling, educational, and above all else, wonderful   41   with a local that all travelers long for.
ex.t: 沿着中国西北部塔克拉玛干沙漠边缘乘坐20小时火车时，我经历了那种所有旅行者都渴望的谦卑、有教育意义，而且最重要的，美妙的   41   与当地人的交流。

ex.s: My husband, our children and I have had wonderful camping experiences over the past ten years.
ex.t: 我的丈夫、我们的孩子和我过去十年中有过美好的露营经历。

ex.s: Leslie Nielsen’s devotion to acting is wonderfully inspiring.
ex.t: 莱斯利·尼尔森对表演的投入极其鼓舞人心。

ex.s: When I do, my box will be full of wonderful things for them."
ex.t: 我那个想象的奶奶的箱子那年春天像魔法一样奏效，后来也是。

ex.s: But I imagine that, while money is indeed wonderful and necessary, rereading an author’s work is the highest currency a reader can pay them.
ex.t: 但我想，虽然金钱确实美好且必不可少，但重读一位作者的作品，是读者能给予他们的最高回报。

ex.s: I am not good at soccer, but that evening it was wonderful.
ex.t: 我不擅长足球，但那天晚上真的很棒。

ex.s: What made that Amazonian evening wonderful?
ex.t: 是什么让那个亚马孙夜晚如此美妙？

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。

ex.s: Don’t forget to stop by Pacific Science Center’s Store while you are here to pick up a wonderful science activity or remember your visit.
ex.t: 在此期间，别忘了顺道去太平洋科学中心的商店，挑选一项精彩的科学活动或纪念品来纪念你的参观。

ex.s: If you’re tired out by Friday night, sleeping in on Saturday could sound wonderful.
ex.t: 如果周五晚上你已经累了，周六睡个懒觉听起来会很美妙。

ex.s: One of the most wonderful migrations in nature is that of the North American monarch butterfly.
ex.t: 自然界中最奇妙的迁徙之一，是北美帝王蝶的迁徙。

ex.s: Lisa: Looking back on my high school life, the most important advice I'd give is these wonderful words from the writer Maya Angelou, She said, "Be a rainbow in somebody else's cloud." So, give your friends a hand when they need it.
ex.t: 丽莎：回顾我的高中生活，我能给出的最重要的建议是作家玛雅·安杰卢这些精彩的话，她说："成为别人乌云中的一道彩虹。"所以，当朋友需要帮助时，伸出你的手。
